verses.text: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.

xrefs.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
saying: “In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”

verses.text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.

verses.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?

xrefs.text: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
What fruit did you reap at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? The outcome of those things is death.

verses.text: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!

xrefs.text: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who pours out lies will perish.
A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who utters lies will not escape.
Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.

verses.text: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

xrefs.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
I am dark, yet lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
Woe is me! For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.

verses.text: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.

xrefs.text: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’

Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?

verses.text: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.

xrefs.text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
